contract: Refresh matchmaking waiting, match-found and end-of-match presentations using the existing ivory, olive, bronze and terracotta theme. Show the selected portrait, actual queue/error/auth status and authoritative results. Remove loadout and alternate-mode links from the queue and remove promotional catchphrases throughout Korean and English UI.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard cancel, 44px actions, labeled Radix dialogs, Escape/dismiss and return focus to the result summary passed. Reduced motion disables lobby and result animations. Darkened small accent/muted text against tinted panels. Screen-reader audio was not tested.

responsive.evidence: Queue checked at 320, 375 and 1440px without horizontal overflow. Match and result overlays occupy exact viewport bounds. Long names truncate; result actions wrap on mobile.

loading.evidence: Real queue displays scanning ring and current connection status; saving status transitions after result messages.

empty.evidence: Unmatched opponent remains an explicitly labeled waiting slot with no fabricated opponent/rating or waiting-time estimate.

error.evidence: Network failure displays an alert, stops scanning, and retry reconnects successfully.

partial.evidence: Missing opponent score displays an em dash. Guests use the guest portrait. Long names and delayed record confirmation remain readable.

success.evidence: Two browser tabs match on an isolated real socket server, enter the game, surrender and see victory/defeat results; result actions and replay work. Draw, 2048, blocked-board and disconnect results verified with server fixtures. Duplicate end and record updates do not reopen dismissed results.

permission.evidence: Guest ranked view presents login and does not enter the queue. Fictional account browser fixture displays its selected dragon icon; no remote account is written.

renderedEvidence.observation: Ivory arena with olive searching slot and one cancel action. No tagline or secondary navigation.
Selected dragon portrait and player name appear in the waiting arena.
Match-found VS animation now uses the site palette and factual entry status.
Victory result from a real local match, authoritative scores and replay/board actions.
Muted terracotta defeat presentation, readable mobile result and controls.
Reduced-motion draw, long name, three actions and recording status.

validation.lint: Changed web files and new browser test passed
validation.sourceAudit: Removed flagged copy from callers and translation dictionaries; catalog prose rewritten as factual descriptions.

limits: Production deployment, live authenticated multiplayer and non-Chromium browsers were not tested.

contractDetails.references: Existing CSS theme tokens, GameEmblem, ProfileIcon, Radix Dialog and Button.
contractDetails.primaryAction: Cancel while searching; replay or view final board after a result.
contractDetails.motion: CSS-only scan and finite emblem/title reveal, with reduced-motion support.
contractDetails.data: No new network/API, schema migration or dependency. Server match logic and recording semantics retained.
